checks: Locations use separate modern hall cards and a shared grouped field card
All location inputs have unique associated labels and court switches have field-specific accessible names
Hall colors reserve colors already used elsewhere and retain the own selected color
Announcement examples stay available in initially collapsed native disclosure controls
Identical location and court snapshots produce zero DOM mutations and preserve nodes, focus and expanded examples
Typing updates singular/plural examples without sending and a field update preserves the current draft and selection
Leaving a text field retains the existing complete location_changed command and shows the shared save status
An early save broadcast preserves newer drafts and queues one follow-up rather than concurrent hall writes
The queued save contains both latest texts after the earlier request completes
Failed hall saves retain the draft and provide an inline retry alongside the shared error status
Retry confirms the draft and leaving an unchanged text sends no redundant request
An external hall change updates its clean fields without replacing another hall draft
Changing a hall color updates its swatch and reserves the new color without losing announcement texts
A disabled Meetingpoint rule greys its saved text while leaving it editable and links to Aufrufe
Field edits keep the partial court_edit contract, update the count and block duplicates while pending
A failed field change rolls back that field and exposes a local error without rebuilding rows
A field broadcast confirms the changed official place and greys the retained service-judge choice
Pausing official rotation retains all stored choices, greys their switches and keeps them configurable
Choices can be changed while rotation is off and remain stored when switching to umpire-only mode
Changing field order and hall assignment moves the existing keyed rows into the correct hall group
Missing halls show an honest empty state while orphaned fields remain editable without exceptions
Removing all fields produces a clean empty state without obsolete switches or groups
Hall icons retain the existing image upload command with the selected hall and filename
A failed icon upload retains the selected file and offers an inline retry
Retrying the icon sends the same image without selecting it again
A logo broadcast updates only its existing preview and ignores removed locations safely
Hall cards and all field switches fit without horizontal scrolling at 1920
Hall cards and all field switches fit without horizontal scrolling at 1280
Hall cards and all field switches fit without horizontal scrolling at 950
Hall cards and all field switches fit without horizontal scrolling at 390
Hall cards and all field switches fit without horizontal scrolling at 320
The Meetingpoint cross-link opens Aufrufe without interrupting the shared audio service
Returning from official settings retains the hall and field nodes and the expanded preview
The selected hall color is shown as a labeled swatch inside the closed dropdown
Every opened color option shows its own swatch, name and selected state
Clicking a swatch saves the same numeric location color command once and closes the list
A failed color save retains the selected swatch with the existing retry action
Arrow keys skip colors already assigned to another hall and keep focus in the combobox
Enter confirms a keyboard-selected color and updates the swatch and hall marker together
Escape dismisses the color list without saving the highlighted alternative
Live hall updates refresh the selected color and reserved options without replacing the open list or focus
Reserved colors remain visible but cannot be selected by clicking their swatch row
Identical live colors cause no mutations in the selected field or its option rows
Clicking outside the palette closes it without changing the selected color
The color field and open palette fit inside the viewport at 1920
The color field and open palette fit inside the viewport at 950
The color field and open palette fit inside the viewport at 390
The color field and open palette fit inside the viewport at 320
Changing settings sections closes the palette and retains its mounted controls
Removing a hall disposes its detached palette and document handlers
Restoring a hall mounts one fresh color control with the right saved swatch
Location edits, field updates and navigation produce no browser exceptions
